text: 商务部公布2027年化肥进口关税配额总量、分配原则及相关程序，2027年化肥进口关税配额总量为1365万吨。其中，尿素330万吨；磷酸氢二铵690万吨；复合肥345万吨。
text_en: The Ministry of Commerce announced the total 2027 fertilizer import tariff quota, allocation principles and related procedures. The total 2027 fertilizer import tariff quota is 13.65 million tons. Of this, urea is 3.3 million tons; diammonium phosphate is 6.9 million tons; compound fertilizer is 3.45 million tons.
